title: Celebrating Mid-Autumn Festival: A Season of Gratitude and Progress
html:
As the Mid-Autumn Festival approaches, SurgicGuide Limited would like to extend our warmest wishes to our colleagues, collaborators, partners, and friends.

The Mid-Autumn Festival is a time for reunion, reflection, and gratitude. At SurgicGuide, we are grateful for the continued support of our partners and for the dedication of the researchers, clinicians, and innovators who share our vision of advancing healthcare through technology.

As a Hong Kong-based biotechnology company, SurgicGuide is committed to advancing novel technologies for precision cancer surgery. Our research focuses on Fluorescence Lifetime Imaging Microscopy (FLIM), combined with artificial intelligence (AI), to support the real-time identification of tumour tissue during surgery.

By bringing advanced imaging and AI closer to the operating room, we aspire to provide surgeons with timely and meaningful information during tumour resection, with the ultimate goal of supporting more precise surgery and reducing the risk associated with positive surgical margins and tumour recurrence.

This Mid-Autumn Festival, we celebrate not only the spirit of togetherness, but also the continued progress made through collaboration, innovation, and scientific discovery.

We wish everyone a joyful and meaningful Mid-Autumn Festival filled with happiness, good health, and success.

SurgicGuide Limited

Advancing Precision. Guiding Surgery. Improving Outcomes.
